def shuffled(xs: list[int], seed: int) -> list[int]:
    """Return the elements of xs in a pseudo-random order determined only by seed.

    The same xs and seed always give the same result. The result is a
    permutation of xs, and xs itself is not changed."""
    post out.len() == xs.len()
    post sorted(out) == sorted(xs)
    ex shuffled([], 1) == []
    ex shuffled([7], 3) == [7]
    m = 2147483648
    state = (seed % m + m) % m
    result = xs.copy()
    i = result.len() - 1
    while i > 0:
        state = (state * 1103515245 + 12345) % m
        j = (state // 65536) % (i + 1)
        tmp = result[i]
        result[i] = result[j]
        result[j] = tmp
        i -= 1
    return result
